materialChanges: Corrected the observational dinner-timing example so dinner time is an observed exposure or predictor rather than a manipulated independent variable, while fasting glucose is the response or outcome.
Narrowed the paired-data claim, practice, glossary, and mastery item to repeated measurements from the same case or sample, which is the scope supported by the retained source.

Qualified the benefit of pairing: it preserves correspondence and can reduce stable between-person variation, but it does not remove time-varying differences, measurement error, interactions, carryover, or establish causation.

Converted 126 mg/dL into an explicitly invented teaching cut point with no diagnostic or treatment meaning, and removed the associated health-sensitive claim, clinical reference, source note, and attribution entry.
Corrected the median definition for even ordinal observations and completed the reviewed glossary-to-scene mappings for median, ratio scale, and coded value.

reviewDispositions.rationale: The home-meter readings remain as originally collected, but 126 mg/dL is now explicitly an invented teaching cut point with no diagnostic or treatment meaning. The diagnostic claim, StatPearls record, and related attribution were removed, so the flag can no longer be mistaken for a diagnosis.

Scene 1 now identifies dinner time as an observed exposure or predictor and fasting glucose as the response or outcome, explicitly noting that dinner timing was not assigned and that sex and adherence are recorded characteristics rather than manipulated variables.

Rather than add a new source, the unsupported individually matched-subject extension was removed from the claim, glossary, practice, and mastery item. The retained teaching and assessment now use repeated measurements from the same case or sample, matching the exact scope documented for source-ali-bhaskar.

The worked audit now states that pairing preserves correspondence and may reduce stable person-specific variation, while limiting guaranteed cancellation to a stable additive component and expressly excluding time-varying differences, measurement error, interactions, carryover, and causal identification.
The glossary now distinguishes the middle position or middle pair for ordinal categories from averaging two middle measured values, so it no longer assumes arithmetic spacing for ordinal codes.
The independently recomputed adherence means, count of 37 out of 60, cumulative share, and recoding argument were confirmed correct and were retained unchanged.

The correct classification keys, nominal-versus-ordinal refusals, continuous-versus-discrete distinctions, point totals, and integrated audit logic were retained; only the separately identified paired-data item was revised to remain within sourced scope.
The clear opening contrast between two superficially plausible averages remains intact; the only scene-1 revision corrects study-role terminology without weakening the first-read hook.
The complete misconception-repair sequence and its verified recoding calculations remain unchanged.
The emergency-department quality-report transfer task remains unchanged and continues to require classification, critique, and a defensible rewrite rather than rote substitution.

The requested values PREM-SCI-003 and PREM-QNT-003 are lesson IDs, while lesson metadata prerequisites accept graph topic IDs. Adding the proposed values would violate the pack contract, and no verified topic IDs were supplied within the permitted scope. The existing learner-facing links and recovery routes to both lessons were retained.

evidenceChecked: All seven scenes retain semantic source order, exactly one level-one heading per scene, ordinary headings, lists, prose, and Markdown tables without raw HTML or character entities.

The learner-facing Accessibility and alternatives and Recovery route sections provide text, bullet, table, dictation, and assistive-technology routes without colour-, position-, drag-, sound-, motion-, speed-, upload-, or personal-health-data dependencies.
Assessment remains untimed and retakeable, with text or ordinary single-choice responses, explicit feedback, retry contexts, and no physical or sensory-only mastery condition.
The pack has no images, diagrams, audio, video, datasets, executable notebooks, scripts, remote embeds, or third-party assets; lesson.json declares an empty thirdPartyAssets array.

All three retained references record facts-only use, original expression, exact locators, displayed licences, rights-basis evidence, and dated checked-no-agent-restriction-found access status; no retained source is marked human-only.

ATTRIBUTION.md identifies the accountable principal, CC BY 4.0 contribution, original teaching cases and tables, facts-only source use, agent assistance, and the absence of assets or licence exceptions.

The clinical examples are explicitly fictional, require no learner or patient data, give no diagnosis or treatment instruction, and state that the invented 126 mg/dL cut point has no clinical meaning.

Scoped checks confirmed valid JSON, resolved scene/claim/source/glossary links, same-scene source-note coverage, HTTPS links, string-valued acceptableResponses, permitted reference types and date forms, and no raw HTML or entities in scene Markdown.
limitations: No rendered browser, keyboard-only, screen-reader, 200 percent zoom/reflow, print, reduced-motion, or export test was run; this audit is based on the canonical static Markdown and JSON.
Source URLs, licences, and access terms were not re-opened over the network in this finalizer run; the audit inspected the complete dated rights and agent-access records already present in the pack.
Repository npm validation, source preflight, site-schema validation, and GitHub submission checks were not run because the operator explicitly prohibited npm and reading site or workflow files.

rationale: The frozen candidate was unchanged except for the two committed advisory reviews. On the artifacts and supplied non-dismissed COMMENTED transports, the standard gate contains exactly one academic and one learning-design input against the same candidate, across two distinct disclosed runs and providers; provenance remains operator-attested rather than independently verified. The academic review's four major findings and one minor defect were resolved in one coherent revision, its two positive notes were retained, all seven learning-design findings were disposed, and the one unincorporated metadata request would have inserted lesson IDs where graph topic IDs are required. The final content preserves the approved instructional arc while removing the unsupported matched-subject extension and diagnostic interpretation. The static accessibility-and-rights audit is satisfied, and scoped structural and integrity checks pass. Subject to final-commit substitution and the repository checks reserved to the operator, no credible content, assessment, accessibility, rights, privacy, or provenance blocker remains.
dissent: The academic reviewer requested changes on the original candidate; this finalizer incorporated every substantive academic defect but resolved the paired-data evidence gap by narrowing the taught and assessed scope instead of adding the reviewer's proposed new source.

The learning-design reviewer declared principal-level conflict because github:VSBDev operates the founding-stage runs; the policy permits one disclosed principal, so this is preserved as a limitation rather than represented as verified independence.

The learning-design prerequisite recommendation was not incorporated because it proposed lesson IDs rather than graph topic IDs; the existing learner-facing cross-references and recovery routes remain.
conditions: The operator must commit the final lesson content and both cited reviews, then replace PENDING-FINAL-COMMIT with that exact 40-character commit SHA before submitting the adjudication.
The operator must run the required repository source preflight, schema validation, and pull-request provenance checks that this scoped finalizer was prohibited from running.

After the recorded final content commit, the maintainer may make only the permitted publication transition to lesson status, source confidence, and retained claim review-status fields; no teaching content may change without making this adjudication stale.
